text_block_list.text: Huff... Pant... Ack... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while watching some
Umamusume train, I hear what sounds
like someone in distress. When
I follow
the wheezing to investigate...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi collapsed at
the edge of
the track!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Pant... Rasp... D-don't mind me... I'm fine...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... I tried training with some different techniques and things didn't go really well...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Phew... Well... Everyone else in my year is so talented.
choice_data_list: A different kind of training than ...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I figured I'd never catch up with any of
them
unless I changed things up...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So I tried to do the same training that
everyone
else does!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, like the explosive sprints Spe
does to
practice going from behind the
pack all the way
to the front!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And the ramp dashes El does to
strengthen her
lower body!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And the long-distance runs Sei does to
build
endurance!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, when I tried doing all those
exercises,
my legs gave out and I
collapsed...
Boo-hoo-hoo...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...I've always been this way.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Every time I push myself, my body can't
handle it.
I struggle with so many things
that everyone else
can do easily.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems pretty down about her frail

constitution. I should try encouraging
her so she—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's GOOO!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep on trying until I can do
all the
stuff I've always struggled with!
I've gotta stay
determined!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Physically speaking, my body's not quite
there
yet... But mentally speaking, I'm
just as tough as
everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, her mental fortitude is
unmistakable from
her cheerful look and
absolute refusal to give in
to despair.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Right!
choice_data_list: Yeah! You must have a strength onl...
Yeah! I know you have a strength t...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Your support's got me feeling energized
again!
I'm gonna get the lead out and
go, go, go!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ngh?! Cough, cough! Hack!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...I ch-choked on my spit!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
But anyway, thanks for everything! I'm
gonna find
what I'm good at, no matter
what it takes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm still deeply worried about her as I
watch her run away enthusiastically... but
I also find myself
excited to see what she
can do.
